panel: every terminal (e.g. ch4 P27, ch2 P24-P31)
what: All five chapter stylesheets force every terminal to `white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere`, overriding the engine: wrapped lines restart at column 0 with no hanging indent, so a wrapped command or stack line looks like a separate line of output.
evidence: go-ch1.css:99, go-ch2.css:41, go-ch3.css:58, go-ch4.css:194, go-ch5.css:90 (`.term { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }`). At 390 every prompt splits as `you@laptop:~/go-ch2$ go run` / `numforms.go`, and ch4 P27's panic trace shows `/home/you/go-` / `ch4/int_zero.go:8 +0x73` with the continuation flush left although the real line is tab-indented. Crop: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-1-5/ev/ch4-p27-term-390.png. engine-refresh-chapter-todo.md §1 lists only the `.term.wrap` copies, not this bare `.term` override.
fix: Delete the five `.term { … }` lines and mark long Go terminals `class="term wrap"` so the engine's per-line hanging indent (continuation under the first character + 2 columns, breaks at spaces only) applies. Before → After (why): `.term { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere }` → engine `.term.wrap` (a wrapped line must read as one line, and file paths must not split mid-token).

what: On the 'line', 'column' and 'message' steps of the editor lens, the red ✗ next to the line number sits on the cream highlight of the hot line, a 6.7:1 pair that breaks the 7:1 rule (DESIGN_SYSTEM: destructive text on paper only).
evidence: Measured on steps 4-6 of P5: `.ed-lines .ln .x` color rgb(176,0,32) on `li.hot` background rgb(255,246,204). Rules: assets/ext/go-ch2.css:70 and :72. Crop of step 5: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-1-5/ev/ch2-p5-editor-step5-390.png.
fix: Before → After (why): `.ed-lines li.hot .ln .x { color: var(--error) }` (inherited) → `.ed-lines li.hot .ln .x { color: var(--ink); }` or keep the ✗ red but give `.ln` a paper background on hot lines (red text is 7.3:1 on paper only; the ✗ shape already carries the meaning).

what: The circuit's expression line draws `a && b` and `a || b` with JetBrains Mono ligatures switched back on, so beginners see joined glyphs instead of the two characters they must type.
evidence: Audit ligature check: P10 `<code class="circ-code">` has font-feature-settings normal. Cause: assets/ext/go-ch5.css:64 `.circ-code { font: 800 1.25rem var(--f-code) !important; }`; the `font` shorthand with !important resets the engine's `font-feature-settings: "calt" 0, "liga" 0 !important` (comic.css:354), and the later chapter rule wins.
fix: Before → After (why): `.circ-code { font: 800 1.25rem var(--f-code) !important }` → `.circ-code { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; }` (longhands don't reset font-feature-settings; code must show the characters a beginner types).

what: The circuit's switch buttons restyle the engine toggle: an open switch (`aria-pressed="false"`) gets a dashed border, which is the engine's disabled look, and a closed one gets the primary yellow; 'Switch a: false' therefore reads as an unavailable button.
evidence: assets/ext/go-ch5.css:60-61 (`.circ-controls .btn[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--yellow) }`, `[aria-pressed="false"] { border-style: dashed }`); DESIGN_SYSTEM §4: disabled = dashed border, no shadow. The markup uses `.btn` with aria-pressed (go/ch5.html:229-230) instead of the engine's toggle class. Crop: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-1-5/ev/ch5-p10-switch-390.png.
fix: Use the engine toggle (`class="path-btn"` with aria-pressed, as the operator buttons above already do) and delete go-ch5.css:60-61. Before → After (why): `.btn[aria-pressed=false] { border-style: dashed }` → engine `.path-btn` off state (solid border; dashed is reserved for disabled, so an off switch must not look unavailable).

what: The truth table's header row has an empty yellow-filled, bordered fourth cell above the borderless '◀ now' marker column, so the table looks like it has a missing column heading.
evidence: `.circ-table th` fills every header cell (go-ch5.css:72) while `.circ-table td.mk` removes borders (go-ch5.css:74). Crop: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-1-5/ev/ch5-p10-switch-390.png.
fix: Render the header's last cell as `<th class="mk"></th>` and style `.circ-table th.mk { border: 0; background: var(--paper); }`, matching the body cells.

what: The odometer needle turns with a 600ms overshooting curve on every step, including each → key press and every Play tick, which is twice Emil's 300ms UI budget and makes keyboard stepping lag.
evidence: assets/ext/go-ch4.css:67 `.motion .od-hand { transition: transform 600ms cubic-bezier(.3, 1.4, .5, 1); }`; measured transition-duration 0.6s with motion on. Reduced motion and 'Animations: off' correctly remove it (measured 'none').
fix: Before → After (why): `transition: transform 600ms cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1)` → `transition: transform var(--dur-move) var(--ease-in-out)` (280ms: on-screen teaching movement under the 300ms cap, no overshoot on a keyboard-driven, often-repeated action).

what: Three chapter keyframes run on every step with the weak built-in `ease-out`, over 300ms, and start from an offset with no opacity: the wheel roll (380ms), the dial jolt (360ms) and the form blank drop (360ms).
evidence: assets/ext/go-ch4.css:81 `od-roll 380ms ease-out` (from translateY(-30%)), :86 `od-jolt 360ms ease-out`, :103 `fm-drop 360ms ease-out` (from translateY(-10px)), keyframes at :87-88 and :122. They restart on each Next press (keyframes are not interruptible).
fix: Before → After (why): `animation: od-roll 380ms ease-out` → `animation: od-roll var(--dur-ui) var(--ease-out)` with the keyframe starting `opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-30%)`; same for `fm-drop`; delete `od-jolt` (the dashed WRAP stamp already signals the wrap). (DESIGN_SYSTEM §5: tokens, ≤300ms, entrances include opacity; delete decoration on repeated actions first.)

what: Scoot's walk between rooms in the terminal-chat picture animates the SVG `x`/`y` attributes for 420ms with the built-in ease-in-out, against the engine's transform-only, ≤300ms, token-easing rules.
evidence: assets/ext/go-ch1.css:63 `.rooms-svg .rm-you { transition: x 420ms ease-in-out, y 420ms ease-in-out; }`; measured transition-property 'x, y', 0.42s with motion on, none under reduced motion and toggle off (correct). The move happens on each → press.
fix: Before → After (why): `transition: x 420ms ease-in-out, y 420ms ease-in-out` (attributes set in go-ch1.js) → wrap Scoot in a `<g>` moved with `style.transform = translate(…)` and `transition: transform var(--dur-move) var(--ease-in-out)` (GPU-only property, 280ms, strong curve).

what: The current-flow dashes on live wires loop forever (0.9s linear, infinite) even when the circuit is scrolled off screen; the engine pauses idle loops off screen only for `svg.char`.
evidence: assets/ext/go-ch5.css:47 `.motion .c-flow { animation: c-flow 0.9s linear infinite; }`; comic.js adds `.idle-off` to `svg.char` only (DESIGN_SYSTEM §5 rule 6). Reduced motion and toggle off stop it (measured).
fix: Before → After (why): `.motion .c-flow { animation: … infinite }` → add `.circ-svg.idle-off .c-flow { animation-play-state: paused; }` and toggle `.idle-off` on `.circ-svg` with an IntersectionObserver in go-ch5.js, or ask the engine to observe `[data-idle]` elements too (no work for frames nobody sees).

panel: part banners, duo cards, boss headings, teasers
what: Every chapter stylesheet re-declares engine components (`.part-h`, `.duo`, `.duo-card`, `.boss-h`, `.teaser`) with raw values (radius 14px, `box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink)`, `background: var(--paper)`), and ch2/ch4 add more hand-rolled cards (`.crew-card`, `.op-card`, `.fm-arg`) the same way, so they no longer follow the token system.
evidence: go-ch1.css:5,21,23,81,82; go-ch2.css:6,18,20,35,36 (+ .crew-card, .op-card); go-ch3.css:5,9,11,47,48; go-ch4.css:5,7,10,12,49 (+ .fm-arg); go-ch5.css:6,10,11,80,81. The engine versions are at comic-widgets.css:230-252 and use `--border`, `--radius-lg`, `--background`. (go-6-10's reviewer reported the same block for ch6.)
fix: Delete the copied `.part-h/.duo/.duo-card/.boss-h/.teaser` rules from the five files and switch the chapter-only cards to tokens. Before → After (why): `.duo-card { border-radius: 14px; background: var(--paper); border: 3px solid var(--ink) }` → engine `.duo-card` (`--radius-lg`, `--background`, `--border`) (one source of truth; a later engine change reaches every chapter).
